translation_note: Each evaluation carries an English (`question_en`) and a French (`question_fr`) form. One side is the original input typed by the user; the other is automatically translated by gpt-4o through Phase 5 (EN→FR) or Phase 6 (FR→EN) of the evaluator. Translations are generally high-quality but may differ in wording from a natively-typed equivalent — keep this in mind when comparing API outputs across languages.
assertion_refresh_sql: SELECT ID_PERSON FROM T_WC_T2S_PERSON WHERE PERSON_NAME = 'John Wayne' LIMIT 1
comment: FASTAPI-TEXT2SQL-215 / -214. The two-word form of a birth name TMDb stores in full ('Marion Robert Morrison'). It failed twice over on 2026-08-26: the resolver refused the alias at 81.1 against a threshold of 87.8 (-214), and the complex-question retry, which HAD identified John Wayne, wrote him into the free-text 'note' and rewrote the question with the same failing name (-215), so the second pass searched exactly what had just failed. The assertion is on the identity returned, not on the path taken: either fix satisfies it, and the user only cares that the card appears. ID 4165 read from the voice-agent rehearsal log of 2026-08-26 (get_person_detail id=4165 answering on Marion Robert Morrison); assertion_refresh_sql re-derives it by name.
keywords: person, alias, birth name, complex question, entity resolution
